Definition: Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
BiblicalUsage: Ashera(h) = "groves (for idol worship)"; 1) a Babylonian (Astarte)-Canaanite goddess (of fortune and happiness), the supposed consort of Baal, her images; 1a) the goddess, goddesses; 1b) her images; 1c) sacred trees or poles set up near an altar
